pages.text: Tonight the five would sleep at the lodge. Covers lay in a row on the wooden floor.
Mei wanted to stay too and fiddled with the bell on their scarf.
The lights went out. Wind sounded outside the window.
The four fell asleep quickly. Only Mei's eyes stayed open.
The floor creaked. Mei pulled the covers up to their nose.
Mei shook the bell gently, hoping someone would wake.
The sound was too soft. The four slept on.
Grandma Bear brought four more little bells. "Ring alone, and only you hear it."
The four woke and each took a bell. Under the covers, all five shook their bells.
The sound filled the lodge. Side by side, the five closed their eyes.
